leads.why: When someone googles you on their phone, there's no real website — the whole funnel is a booking page. Booking works, but South Austin clients don't get a branded mobile shop page first. A clean mobile site would fix that.

Your online presence is mostly Facebook and directories — when someone googles you on their phone, there's no real website to open. People can't quickly see services, hours, or tap to book. A clean mobile site would give Round Rock clients one trusted place to read, call, and book.

The claimed website often won't load on a phone, so people tapping Website from Google hit a dead end instead of a branded spa page. A clean mobile site that actually opens would sit in front of booking and build trust.
